name: Sharing inside a project
summary: Sharing with named project users rather than by public link: shared folders, measurement visibility and shared progress views.

roles.note: Measurement sharing permissions are in CAPT-FEAT-04. Shared folders have no permission string or code.

nfr.statement: Number of users one item can be shared with in a single action.

requirements.title: Shared folders of project links
requirements.statement: Site admins can create folders with names unique in the project, add and organise links in them, and share a folder with chosen users at set permission levels. Only those users can open it, a removed user loses access at once, and sharing an empty folder is allowed with a warning.

sources.title: Prior PRDs - Public sharing, shared content, and permissions and sharing (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

open_checks: No shared-folder code was found in the repositories read for this migration; the permission levels are an open PRD question

acceptance_criteria.given: A project that already has a folder named Handover
acceptance_criteria.when: A site admin creates another folder named Handover
acceptance_criteria.then: They are asked for a different name

acceptance_criteria.given: A user removed from a shared folder

requirements.title: Public measurements are visible to all project users but editable by few
requirements.statement: A measurement's creator can make it public so every project user sees it. Only the creator, admins and the measurement's assignees can edit it; anyone else is told they lack permission.

sources.title: Prior PRDs - Public sharing, shared content, and permissions and sharing (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

open_checks: CAPT-REQ-013 covers private-unless-shared measurements from code; check the edit rule against it before changing either

acceptance_criteria.given: A measurement its creator has made public
acceptance_criteria.when: A project user who is not creator, admin or assignee tries to edit it
acceptance_criteria.then: The edit is refused with a permission message

requirements.title: Sharing a saved progress view gives each recipient their own copy
requirements.statement: Only a saved view's owner can share it, with up to 100 other users at once and never with themselves. System default views can't be shared. Each recipient gets an independent copy, renamed if they already have a view of that name, and it becomes their default when it is their first view of an auto-default type.
